{{Quote|Claing can even bring a Jedi to his knees.|patron of the "Food and Drink" café on Nierport VII|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise">''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]''</ref>}}
'''Claing juice''' was a strong, red-colored [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage made from fermented [[claing bush]] berries, native to the satellite-moon [[Nierport VII]].

For the uninitiated, as was the case with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], it could sear the lips and tongue and "burn like blazing fire" as it was imbibed, causing the eyes to involuntarily flow with tears.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise" />
